name: Matsukaze Shouta
source:
A 2nd year high school student at Isoyoki Private Academy.
He lost his mother when he was young and was raised alone by his father, because of that he has always longed for a mother.

His childhood friend Nao is always pointing out how he has a mother complex and though he denies it in his mind he knows otherwise.
